data.name: Fightcore Forge
data.detailed_description:
"Welcome to Fightcore Forge! For your entertainment, our AI-powered contestants will go head-to-head in adrenaline-pumping battles within the electrifying arena. With each riveting encounter, Fightcore Forge brings the future of combat sports to life, promising heart-stopping action that will leave you on the edge of your seat. Prepare to be amazed as the champions rise, and a new era of robotic warfare is forged before your very eyes!"

A new industry has recently emerged in the world: multi-purpose fighting robots that need to be trained for warfare. How about creating new funds by turning this training into a show? You, as robots, will have to fight against each other to achieve the best performances!

Gameplay

Local Multiplayer

Challenge your friends to find who is the best! Play with up to four controllers, or use the classic keyboard option for two to six players on a single keyboard. You will face off against each other in the arenas filled with teleporters, power-ups, and moving objects. Whether you're playing 1v1 or in a group, you'll find everything you need for a fun-filled experience with friends.

Online Multiplayer

Play with strangers or your friends across three game modes:

  • Duel allows you to fight in 1 versus 1 to determine who is the best!

  • Contest is a team versus team game mode with three players per team. It requires more strategy and cooperation to achieve victory!

  • Brawl is a free-for-all with up to eight players in the arena where you will test your skills against constant hostility!

data.short_description: Confront opponents and friends as a training robot in a maze arena. Playable online or in local up to 6 player, have some fun driving around and shooting with the help of power-ups and strategy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-6500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce GTX 1050
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
